messages:
Maggie: Quick sync — can we schedule a 60m security/privacy review next week for threat modeling + audit prep + access reviews?
Proposed times: Tue 10am PT / Wed 4pm PT / Thu 2pm PT.
Agenda draft:
```
1) Threat model walkthrough (20m)
2) Audit checklist gaps (20m)
3) Access & key rotation plan (10m)
4) Open items & next steps (10m)
```
Please react with :thumbsup: for Tue, :eyes: for Wed, :calendar: for Thu. Add any agenda items below. cc @Kevin @Sanjay @Julia

Kevin: Wed 4pm PT works best for me — we have an infra release Tue morning so can't do Tue. Also propose adding a short section (5-10m) on Dedicated customer KMS integration.

Sanjay: Thu is OK but can we do 1pm PT instead of 2pm? I have a cross-region standup at 3. If Wed is the majority I'm flexible.

Julia: I can do Tue or Wed. FYI we should include someone from compliance/legal — tagging Anita from legal-compliance. Also please add an item about audit evidence for RBAC changes.

Maggie: Thanks — sounds like Wed 4pm PT is the best fit so far. I'll tentatively schedule Wed 4pm PT and invite Anita + compliance.
Please add any pre-reads to the doc: https://docs.redwood.example.com/security/reviews/threat-model (add diagrams and any audit artifacts).

AuditBot: Created calendar event "Security & Compliance Review" — Wed 2025-09-10 16:00 PT — invites sent to Maggie, Kevin, Sanjay, Julia, Anita.

Maggie: Updated agenda to include: Dedicated KMS (5m) and RBAC audit evidence (5m). Owners: Maggie (facilitator), Kevin (KMS), Julia (evidence).

Kevin: I'll prep a short slide + example KMS config snippet.

Sanjay: Added threat model diagram to the doc and flagged one risk (privileged key rotation).

Julia: Added RBAC export from last quarter to the doc under "audit_evidence".

Maggie: Perfect — thanks everyone. I will send the final invite and agenda by EOD. If anyone else should be included (SRE, Support, Product) reply here. :thumbsup:
